level_ten.title: Black Hole

level_thirteen.title: Shadow Walk
level_thirteen.description: Tassadar becomes Stealthed and Unrevealable, but cannot attack or use Abilities for 1.5 seconds. While this effect is active, gain 40% increased Movement Speed and 35 Armor.  Can be cast while Channeling Shock Ray.

level_sixteen.title: Psychic Shock
level_sixteen.description: Psionic Storm deals damage 25% faster.

level_twenty.title: Force Barrier
level_twenty.description: Increase the duration of Force Wall by 0.5 seconds, its cast range by 50%, and reduce its cooldown by 10 seconds.

level_one.title: Psi-Infusion
level_one.description: Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.  Passive: Increase the cast range of Psionic Storm by 33%.

level_four.title: Electric Fence
level_four.description: Force Wall deals 92 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

level_seven.title: Psionic Echo
level_seven.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

level_ten.title: Archon
level_ten.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.  Resonance Beam: Deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the target and splashes 70 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

level_thirteen.title: Feedback
level_thirteen.description: When an enemy Hero is affected by Psionic Storm, Resonance Beam's Slow is increased to 50% and it reduces Physical Armor by 25.

level_sixteen.title: Psychic Shock
level_sixteen.description: Psionic Storm deals damage 25% faster.

level_twenty.title: Twilight Archon
level_twenty.description: Basic Attacks while in Archon form increase its duration by 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Extra-Wound Timers
level_one.description: The final grenade launched from Frag Launcher deals 100% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

level_four.title: Taste For Explosions
level_four.description: Quest: Hitting a Hero with Frag Launcher increases its damage by 0.2%, up to 40%.

level_seven.title: Sticky Wicket
level_seven.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Steel Trap are Silenced for 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: RIP-Tire
level_ten.description: Create a motorized bomb with 530 (+4% per level) Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement.  RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 (+4% per level) to enemies on the edge.

level_thirteen.title: Ripper Air
level_thirteen.description: Junkrat is knocked back 50% farther by Concussion Mine. Additionally, Concussion Mine's cooldown is reduced by 12 seconds if only Junkrat is hit.

level_sixteen.title: Endless Nades
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Frag Launcher reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Rolling Thunder
level_one.description: Passive: Chain Lightning bounces an additional time.  For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. If the target is an enemy Hero, then he also deals damage to them equal to 3% of their maximum Health and healing for the same amount.

level_four.title: Mana Tide
level_four.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Maelstrom Weapon
level_seven.description: Quest: Basic Attack Heroes while Windfury's Movement Speed bonus is active.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, increase the Movement Speed bonus of Windfury to 40% and Thrall's Basic Attacks deal 40 additional damage.  Reward: After hitting 55 Heroes, Thrall permanently gains 15% increased Movement Speed and his Basic Attacks gain an additional 75 damage.  Mythic Reward: After hitting 100 Heroes, Frostwolf Resilience healing restores 200% more Health.

level_ten.title: Sundering
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

level_thirteen.title: Frostwolf's Grace
level_thirteen.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

level_sixteen.title: Tempest Fury
level_sixteen.description: The final strike of Windfury hits 3 times for 75% normal damage. These hits do not provide quest progress.

level_twenty.title: Wind Rush
level_twenty.description: Activate to immediately teleport to a target location and gain Windfury.

level_one.title: Patchwork Creation
level_one.description: Gain 3 Armor for every unit afflicted with Vile Gas, stacking up to 8 times. While Shambling Horror is active, this Armor amount is doubled.  Passive: Increase regeneration effects and all healing received by 15%.

level_four.title: Tenderizer
level_four.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds and restore 1.75% of Stitches' maximum Health.

level_seven.title: Serrated Edge
level_seven.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook deals bonus damage equal to 5% of their maximum Health, reduces Hook's cooldown by 4 seconds, and restores 35 Mana.

level_ten.title: Gorge
level_ten.description: Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.

level_thirteen.title: Meat Hook
level_thirteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook heals Stitches for 20% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. While active, Basic Attacks against the Hero hit refresh the duration of this effect.

level_sixteen.title: Pulverize
level_sixteen.description: All enemies hit by Slam are Slowed by 70% for 0.75 seconds and Heroes have their Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Hungry Hungry Stitches
level_twenty.description: For 4 seconds after using Gorge, Stitches can teleport a short distance to additional targets and Gorge them. Enemies are Slowed by 75% for 1 second after Gorge ends.

level_one.title: Searing Light
level_one.description: Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemy Heroes in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed.

level_four.title: Repeated Offense
level_four.description: Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 30% farther.  Quest: Every time Detainment Strike stuns a Hero, increase the stun damage by 10, up to 60.  Reward: After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.

level_seven.title: Energized Cord
level_seven.description: Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 130% of the damage against Heroes and 70% of the damage against non-Heroes.  Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.  Passive: Increase Basic Attack Range by 1.1.

level_ten.title: Resurrect
level_ten.description: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.  Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

level_thirteen.title: Converging Force
level_thirteen.description: Enemies hit by the outer area are pushed slightly toward the center.

level_sixteen.title: Reservoir of Hope
level_sixteen.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 55.

level_twenty.title: Light Speed
level_twenty.description: Resurrected allies gain 200% increased Movement Speed, decaying over 4 seconds. While a resurrected ally remains alive, Resurrect's next cooldown recharges 100% faster.

level_one.title: Increasing Clarity
level_one.description: Quest: Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, this center damage bonus is increased to 180.
